# Pedro F. Rackebrandt

> Pedro F. Rackebrandt. Political economy and regime dynamics. MPhil Economics, Merton College, Oxford.

MPhil in Economics, University of Oxford, Merton. Undergraduate dissertation at the University of Manchester on volatility as a measure of price dislocation in commodity markets. Later worked in brokerage at a family office.

I study the incentive structures of hybrid regimes. SI will let agents handle nearly any task that can be automated, which risks dissolving the social contract between elites and everyone else under democratic systems. Bad or good, we must adapt. How?

In my view there are two cases, with regional variants. a) technology outgrows gov debt, b) it doesn't. Unless a) is large enough to achieve post economic abundance, questions of legitimacy will arrive. For such optimisation, is that I'd love to answer the how to implement a given regime, under what conditions, and for which society.

Aristotle and Polybius traced how constitutions decay and settled on the mixed republic, a "politeia" balancing claims of wealth and power against free birth, more resistant to degeneration over time. When a) is solved, this directionally motivates for multiplanetary civilisation optimisation. Best time to be alive!

## Research

- [When regimes cycle](https://rackebrandt.pe/papers/when-regimes-cycle/): Working paper, 2026. Topic: Regimes. Why countries keep swinging between democracy and autocracy, and what starts and stops the swings.
- [How many tests was it really?](https://rackebrandt.pe/papers/how-many-tests/): Working paper, 2026. Topic: Finance. With Sebastian Winzker. How high the bar for a backtested trading rule should be once you count every rule you tried.
- [Reversed by our own replication](https://rackebrandt.pe/papers/reversed-by-replication/): Working paper, 2026. Topic: AI. A registered replication in which two of three signals for catching LLM extraction errors reversed.

## Tools

- [Rikuy](https://rikuy-3dl.pages.dev/) (Live, Open source): A LaTeX editor where you type straight onto the typeset page. TeX Live runs inside the browser, so there is nothing to install and no account. It works offline and opens and saves Word files.
- Frontier (Coming soon): A research agent that works overnight and shows, as a map, how ideas in frontier research connect.
